title: WiFi
description: Station networks in priority order (slot 0 first), reconnect policy and the provisioning access point.

keys.name: sta_enabled
keys.title: Station enabled
keys.description: Connect to the configured networks. Off = radio idle (portal still available if enabled).

keys.name: hostname
keys.title: Hostname
keys.description: DHCP/mDNS hostname. Empty = espos-<last 4 hex of MAC>.

keys.name: psk0
keys.title: Network 1 password
keys.description: Empty for an open network, else 8..63 characters (WPA).

keys.name: bssid0
keys.title: Network 1 BSSID pin
keys.description: Optional aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff to pin one access point (no roaming).

keys.name: backoff_max_s
keys.title: Reconnect backoff cap
keys.description: Exponential backoff between rounds over all networks, 1 s doubling up to this cap, ±25 % jitter.

keys.name: dhcp_tmo_s
keys.title: DHCP timeout
keys.description: Associated but no IP after this long counts as a failed attempt.

keys.name: connect_tmo_s
keys.title: Connect timeout
keys.description: Safety net if the driver never reports a result.

keys.name: portal_enabled
keys.title: Provisioning access point
keys.description: Bring up the setup access point when no network is configured or nothing connects for a while.

keys.name: portal_after_s
keys.title: Portal after
keys.description: Seconds without a connection before the access point comes up (0 networks configured: immediately).

keys.name: portal_psk
keys.title: Access point password
keys.description: Empty = open network. 8..63 characters for WPA2.

keys.name: ps_mode
keys.title: Power save
keys.description: WiFi modem power save. 'none' keeps latency lowest.
